Thanks Lena and Arjun for the files. Quick checklist from our side before we flip this live:

1) EIN verification: well validate the W-9 against your EIN (12-3456789). If anything mismatches well flag it.
2) ACH micro-deposit: preferred path for low-volume payees. We can run two micro-deposits (sent same day) and ask you to confirm amounts. This enables ACH auto-clearing in three business days.
3) Wire fallback: we can enable wire as a fallback for the first payout. Wires must include the full bank letter PDF on file for audit.
4) Remit mapping: our payments team needs the remit CSV sample to include a PO column named "po_number" and a separate "remit_reference" column. The sample you included looks close but the date format should be YYYY-MM-DD for our ingestion.

Marissa and Jordan looping you in to validate PO field mapping and to schedule the micro-deposit run.

Next steps requested from Stonebridge: confirm you want ACH as primary or wire-first, and confirm the person who will validate micro-deposit amounts (name + email).

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Manager, Supplier Onboarding
